recognize_zh: 骨髓切片幾乎完全被脂肪細胞取代，脂肪間只剩少量間質、微血管與零星細胞，看不到成群的造血細胞，左側為骨小樑，符合再生不良性貧血（aplastic anemia）的極度低細胞性骨髓；病因（如苯暴露）無法由形態判斷。
features: Markedly hypocellular marrow, nearly entirely replaced by adipocytes
Only scant residual stromal cells, capillaries and scattered dark cells between fat spaces
No identifiable clusters of erythroid, myeloid or megakaryocytic precursors
Bony trabecula along the left edge and at upper right
No fibrosis, granulomas or abnormal infiltrate; low resolution precludes assessment of residual cell types
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a markedly hypocellular marrow in which the intertrabecular space is almost entirely replaced by adipose tissue, with only scant residual stromal cells and small vessels. Erythroid, myeloid and megakaryocytic elements are not identifiable in this field, and there is no fibrosis, granuloma or abnormal infiltrate. Image resolution limits evaluation of residual lymphocytes and plasma cells. Findings are consistent with severe aplastic anemia; the etiology, such as benzene exposure, cannot be determined morphologically and requires clinical history.

ddx.vs: Hypoplastic MDS retains foci with dysplastic megakaryocytes or erythroid precursors, increased CD34+ blasts or MDS-defining cytogenetics.

ddx.dx: Normal age-related hypocellularity or tangential/subcortical biopsy
ddx.vs: Subcortical marrow in older adults can be fatty, so cellularity must be assessed in an adequate core of deeper intertrabecular spaces and correlated with age and blood counts.
Hypocellular AML shows residual cellular areas composed of blasts that are CD34 or MPO-positive.
Post-therapy aplasia looks similar but may show serous fat atrophy or edema and is identified by treatment history and recovery.
